import java.util.*;
import java.io.*;

public class Main {
    public static int my_find(String s1, String s2, int start) {
        for (int i = start; i <= s1.length() - s2.length(); i++) {
            boolean match = true;
            for (int j = 0; j < s2.length(); j++) {
                if (s1.charAt(i + j) != s2.charAt(j)) {
                    match = false;
                    break;
                }
            }
            if (match) return i;
        }
        return -1;
    }

    public static void main(String[] args) throws IOException {
        BufferedReader br = new BufferedReader(new InputStreamReader(System.in));
        String s1 = br.readLine().trim();
        
        int pos = my_find(s1, "at", 1);
        String s2 = s1.substring(0, pos) + '@' + s1.substring(pos + 2);
        
        StringBuilder ans = new StringBuilder();
        int i = my_find(s2, "dot", 1), last = 0;
        while (i != -1 && i < s2.length() - 3) {
            ans.append(s2.substring(last, i));
            ans.append('.');
            last = i + 3;
            i = my_find(s2, "dot", last);
        }
        ans.append(s2.substring(last));
        
        System.out.print(ans.toString());
    }
}
